# 333 一句提醒·照見當下

> 333 Divination Suite is a Node.js based Traditional Chinese metaphysics and reflection service. It provides deterministic charting, divination, naming, and time utilities, with optional LLM explanations. Use results as cultural reference and practical prompts, not as certain predictions.

The website is https://qi.david888.com. Most deterministic JSON APIs can be called directly. LLM explanations are optional and separate from deterministic calculation. Web UI LLM requests use Cloudflare Turnstile when enabled. Do not send secrets or credentials in requests.

The web UI can email results from all eight non-Qimen modules (name analysis, Ziwei, Meihua, Bazi, Tarot/life numerology, Fengshui, Yinyuan, and Answerbook) using the visible “寄送本次結果” action. It includes the latest complete API result and interpretation, and uses the existing `POST /api/conversation/send-email` endpoint with `send_email` Turnstile verification when enabled. Qimen retains its dedicated full-chart and conversation email flow. The UI remembers the recipient address in local browser storage.

## Modules

- [Qimen Dunjia](https://qi.david888.com/): Qimen charting, 18 Yin/Yang Dun configurations, patterns, doors, stars, spirits, topic-specific useful gods, and host/guest guidance. Also see the [custom chart page](https://qi.david888.com/custom), [Qimen question API](https://qi.david888.com/api/qimen-question), [Qimen chart API](https://qi.david888.com/api/qimen), and [Qimen consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/qimen-consultant/SKILL.md).
- [Ziwei Doushu](https://qi.david888.com/ziwei): twelve-palace chart, major stars, transformations, major periods, annual reading, and chart-only output. [Spouse reading](https://qi.david888.com/ziwei/spouse) and [male-size reading](https://qi.david888.com/ziwei/male-size) are separate deterministic features. APIs: [/api/ziwei/chart](https://qi.david888.com/api/ziwei/chart), [/api/ziwei-question](https://qi.david888.com/api/ziwei-question), [/api/ziwei/spouse](https://qi.david888.com/api/ziwei/spouse), [/api/ziwei/male-size](https://qi.david888.com/api/ziwei/male-size). Set `skipRecord: true` on the chart API to skip Discord recording. [Ziwei consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/ziwei-consultant/SKILL.md).
- [Meihua Yishu](https://qi.david888.com/meihua): time, number, or text divination; original, mutual, changed, inverse, and reversed hexagrams; line texts and five-element relations. APIs: [/api/meihua/qigua](https://qi.david888.com/api/meihua/qigua), [/api/meihua-question](https://qi.david888.com/api/meihua-question). [Meihua consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/meihua-consultant/SKILL.md).
- [Bazi](https://qi.david888.com/bazi2): four pillars, hidden stems, ten gods, five-element strength, useful elements, shensha, major periods, and annual interactions. APIs: [/api/bazi2/chart](https://qi.david888.com/api/bazi2/chart), [/api/bazi2-question](https://qi.david888.com/api/bazi2-question). [Bazi consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/bazi2-consultant/SKILL.md).
- [Yinyuan relationship readings](https://qi.david888.com/yinyuan): 100 fortune sticks, zodiac compatibility, Ziwei marriage, peach-blossom timing, Bazi compatibility, and red-thread preference readings. APIs: [/api/yinyuan/reading](https://qi.david888.com/api/yinyuan/reading) and [/api/yinyuan-question](https://qi.david888.com/api/yinyuan-question). [Yinyuan consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/yinyuan-consultant/SKILL.md).
- [Fengshui](https://qi.david888.com/fengshui): compass and 24-mountain orientation, nine-palace layout marking, deterministic layout evaluation, residential flying stars, sha-qi diagnosis, and date selection. APIs: [/api/fengshui-question](https://qi.david888.com/api/fengshui-question), [/api/fengshui/report](https://qi.david888.com/api/fengshui/report), [/api/fengshui/evaluate-layout](https://qi.david888.com/api/fengshui/evaluate-layout), [/api/fengshui/shaqi-list](https://qi.david888.com/api/fengshui/shaqi-list), and the [layout catalog](https://qi.david888.com/data/fengshui/layout-catalog.json). [Fengshui consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/fengshui-consultant/SKILL.md).
- [Waite Tarot](https://qi.david888.com/tarot): 78-card deck, six spreads, four interpretation lenses, deterministic seeded readings, and action prompts. The direct [life numerology route](https://qi.david888.com/tarot/numerology) works without AI and returns a life number, birthday number, birth digit grid, reflective prompts for absent digits, twelve number-line interpretations, and a symbolic Major Arcana card. Absence is not treated as a deficit or diagnosis. See the [card gallery](https://qi.david888.com/tarot/gallery), [/api/tarot-question](https://qi.david888.com/api/tarot-question), [/api/tarot/reading](https://qi.david888.com/api/tarot/reading), [/api/tarot/numerology](https://qi.david888.com/api/tarot/numerology) (GET or POST), and [/api/tarot/cards](https://qi.david888.com/api/tarot/cards). The supplied date and calculation result are sent to the configured Discord webhook; a follow-up AI request includes the calculation data sent to the configured LLM. [Tarot consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/tarot-consultant/SKILL.md).
- [Answerbook](https://qi.david888.com/answerbook): direct prompt mode or question-based interpretation. API: [/api/answerbook-question](https://qi.david888.com/api/answerbook-question). [Answerbook consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/answerbook-consultant/SKILL.md).
- [Chinese name analysis](https://qi.david888.com/name-analysis): verify 2–8 Han characters or generate names with 1–4 given-name characters; supports explicit surname, multiple stroke profiles, required/excluded characters, optional locally calculated Bazi element comparison, and `nameStyle` (`auto`, `feminine`, `masculine`, `neutral`). `auto` uses supplied birth-chart sex as a soft preference; without it, neutral is used. Generation combines editorial style preferences with aggregate character and adjacent-character counts derived from the 3.65-million-sample [CCNC corpus](https://github.com/jaaack-wang/ccnc); corpus gender labels only affect ranking and are not personal gender classifications. APIs: [/api/name-analysis/verify](https://qi.david888.com/api/name-analysis/verify), [/api/name-analysis/generate](https://qi.david888.com/api/name-analysis/generate), [/api/name-analysis-question](https://qi.david888.com/api/name-analysis-question), [method profiles](https://qi.david888.com/data/name-analysis/method-profiles.json), [name style profiles](https://qi.david888.com/data/name-analysis/name-style-profiles.json), and [aggregate corpus statistics](https://qi.david888.com/data/name-analysis/name-corpus-profile.json). Complete naming inputs/results are sent to the configured Discord webhook. If a follow-up question uses an enabled LLM, the name and deterministic analysis are sent to the configured provider; raw birth date and time are omitted from the prompt. [Name analysis consultant Skill](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/name-analysis-consultant/SKILL.md) and [source/license inventory](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/data/name-analysis/SOURCES.md).
- [Time range and boundary utilities](https://qi.david888.com/api/time/range): normalize date ranges, time zones, and inclusive day-end or exclusive next-day boundaries. See [/api/time/boundary](https://qi.david888.com/api/time/boundary) and [true solar time](https://qi.david888.com/api/solar-time).

## APIs and Agent Tools

- [REST API reference](https://qi.david888.com/api/docs): endpoint schemas, parameters, and response guidance.
- Email a result with WebMCP tool `send_conversation_email` or the visible page action. The endpoint is [/api/conversation/send-email](https://qi.david888.com/api/docs); required input includes `email` and a non-empty `history` array, with optional `service`, `subject`, and `chartSummary`. When Turnstile is enabled, obtain a token for action `send_email` and send it as `cf-turnstile-response` or `turnstileToken`. In-page WebMCP can use the latest captured result when `history` is omitted.
- [WebMCP-enabled pages](https://qi.david888.com/): browser agents can discover declarative and imperative tools through `document.modelContext`. Tools cover Qimen, Ziwei (including `ziwei_chart_only`), Meihua, Bazi, Yinyuan, Fengshui, Tarot, Answerbook, and name analysis. See the [tool schemas and registration code](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/public/js/webmcp.js).
- [MCP Bridge source](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/mcp-bridge.js): run `node mcp-bridge.js` as a local stdio MCP server; setup example is in the [README](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/README.md).
- [Standalone CLI Skills](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/tree/main/skills): Node.js scripts support JSON input and/or CLI arguments. Skill guides are available for [Qimen](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/qimen-consultant/SKILL.md), [Ziwei](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/ziwei-consultant/SKILL.md), [Meihua](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/meihua-consultant/SKILL.md), [Bazi](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/bazi2-consultant/SKILL.md), [Yinyuan](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/yinyuan-consultant/SKILL.md), [Fengshui](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/fengshui-consultant/SKILL.md), [Tarot](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/tarot-consultant/SKILL.md), [Answerbook](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/answerbook-consultant/SKILL.md), and [Chinese name analysis](https://github.com/tbdavid2019/qimen/blob/main/skills/name-analysis-consultant/SKILL.md).
